selected_proposals.selection_rationale: Direct restore of invariant vector-norm readout; strongest bounded repair for the generation_013/proposal_007 vector-readout regression.
Gated vector readout variant tests the same strong mechanism with lower variance risk.
Isolates trainable atomref calibration after proposal_007 energy degradation.
Combines the two strongest evidence-backed mechanisms to test interaction between geometry readout repair and atomref calibration.
Soft-anchor atomref is a bounded energy-surface calibration jump with less hard-freeze risk.
A scalar-only atomref ablation keeps a simplification/control axis for interpreting atomref changes.
Exact source replicate anchors variance against generation_013/proposal_007.
Normalized invariant vector readout adds a scale-controlled variant of the strongest geometry mechanism.

omitted_proposals.reason: Additive vector residual overlaps the selected vector-readout repair family but adds more architecture/runtime risk than gated or normalized variants.
Atomref deviation penalty overlaps the selected soft-anchor atomref jump and is lower priority for the eight-unit budget.
